headline: VIVIZ win first ruling in contract suit with ex-agency
sub: Court says trust with Big Planet Made had broken down
caption:
VIVIZ members Eunha, SinB and Umji have won the first ruling in their exclusive contract dispute with former agency Big Planet Made Entertainment.

The three former GFRIEND members had taken legal action saying they had not received about 340 million won in settlement payments. The court ruled in their favor, finding that the relationship of trust between the members and the agency had broken down.

📌 Source: Yonhap News (via Korean media)
